M1.reason: Silhouette overlap is below 0.80 in every view (front/back 0.745, left/right 0.524, top/below 0.566), so 2 is ruled out. In the left and right views the original's front legs are long, jointed and curve forward and down to claws close to the ground. The reproduction's front legs go out flat at the height of the top of the body like a boom, then drop straight down as thick red posts. That puts mass where the original has none and leaves out the forward reach. The body is a smooth egg, while the original's has a humped, angular dome and a pinched rear. In the top view the original is widest across the front shoulders and the reproduction is widest in the middle. The general crab-on-four-legs outline is still there, so it gets 1, not 0.

M2.reason: The measured size is 25.9 x 19.2 x 13.2 for both, which matches the original on every axis, and almost nothing falls outside the box (offShare 0.001 to 0.002).

M3.reason: The main parts are there in roughly the right places: a body with a pale dome on top, two long front legs, two short rear legs, a mouth underneath with teeth and dark claw tips. Several have the wrong shape. The front legs are a straight thin rod plus a fat straight red block with no joints, where the original has segmented, curved, clawed limbs. The mouth is a flat octagon in a red panel. The original's mouth is a recessed ring of fangs set in fleshy folds, seen in the below and back views. The original's rear legs are stubby claws tucked against the sides of the body, while the reproduction's are separate red feet set further out.

M4.reason: The measured mean deltaE is 21.7, above the pass line of 15, and every view is 17 or higher (front 24.8, front-right 25.7). The regions do get roughly the right colour families: tan-brown shell, cream dome, red legs. Some regions are off, though. The front legs are flat saturated red from top to bottom, where the original's are brown on the upper parts and blotchy red only toward the claws. The underside is a large flat red panel, where the original's is a mottled brown and red flesh texture.

M5.reason: Some of the original's markings are attempted in the right places: red speckle on the cream dome, ridges on the back of the shell, teeth around the mouth. The shell texture is wrong. The reproduction draws a regular brown plaid or wicker grid over the whole body (back, sides, top), where the original has organic rib and vein patterns with dark creases. The original's mottled flesh and blood wear on the legs and underside is replaced by flat red, and the mouth detail is a simple octagon instead of layered fangs.

M6.reason: Side by side, a player would not take it for the original. The boom-like front legs ending in straight red posts, the smooth egg body, and the plaid basket texture read as a different creature or a toy. The original is a hunched, organic crab with curved clawed forelegs. The angled views (front-left, back-right) show the gap most clearly.

M7.reason: The front matches the original's: the dome faces the front camera and the forelegs point forward in the side views. The model is upright and stands on its claws at the same ground level as the original in every view.

M8.reason: The reproduction has 1096 triangles against the original's 478, more than twice the limit of 956. No check errors were reported, and nothing looks open, inside out or floating.
